The structure of Na2Mg(FeO2)4 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 19 atoms and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies Fe in a tetrahedral O environment (four neighbors per Fe center), while Mg and Na adopt six- and 12-neighbor oxygen environments, respectively. Corner-sharing between Fe tetrahedra and Mg 6-vertex polyhedra is observed, alongside edge- and face-sharing between Fe tetrahedra and Na 12-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 19 sites.
